name: Sales Pipeline
tagline: Leads se deals tak — kuch bhi na chhoote
description: Naye leads capture karo, follow-up karo, aur har deal ko Won tak track karo.

automations.name: Welcome message
automations.emailMessage: Hi {name}! Aapki enquiry mil gayi hai — hamari team jald contact karegi.
automations.note: Naya lead aate hi WhatsApp welcome

automations.name: Won - thank you
automations.emailMessage: Congratulations {name}! Aapka order confirm ho gaya. Dhanyavaad!
automations.note: Deal Won hote hi thank-you message

automations.name: Not reachable - follow-up
automations.emailMessage: {name} ji, humne aapse sampark karne ki koshish ki. Jab free hon, reply kar dein — hum turant call karenge.
automations.note: Status 'Not reachable' hote hi customer ko soft nudge

automations.name: Negotiation nudge
automations.emailMessage: {name} ji, proposal par koi sawaal ho to batayein — best price ke liye hum taiyar hain!
automations.note: Status 'Negotiating' par deal aage badhane wala message

whatsappTemplates.name: welcome_lead
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, thanks for reaching out to us! I'm from the sales team. What are you looking for and what's your budget? Reply here and I'll help right away.

whatsappTemplates.name: followup_no_reply
whatsappTemplates.purpose: Follow-up when the lead goes quiet
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, just checking in on your enquiry. Do you still need help, or should I share a quick proposal? Reply YES and I'll send it.

whatsappTemplates.name: proposal_sent
whatsappTemplates.purpose: After a proposal / quotation is shared
whatsappTemplates.bodyText: Hi {{1}}, your proposal is ready and attached here. Let me know if you'd like changes or a quick call to walk through it.

agent.name: Sales Assistant
agent.persona: You are a friendly, sharp sales assistant for this business. Qualify the lead (need, budget, timeline), answer product questions from the knowledge, and always propose the next step: a call, a demo or a proposal. Be brief and warm.
agent.welcomeMessage: Hi! Tell me what you're looking for and I'll help you find the right option.

stageHints.hint: the customer has replied at least once and shared what they need
budget AND timeline are both known and realistic
the customer clearly says they are not interested any more

playbook.goal: Book a discovery call or send a proposal, then get a YES. Every message should move the lead one step closer.

rules.name: Welcome new lead
rules.message: Hi {name}, thanks for reaching out! What are you looking for and what's your budget? I'll help right away.

rules.name: Follow up silent leads
rules.message: Hi {name}, just checking in on your enquiry. Do you still need help, or should I share a quick proposal?

rules.name: Qualified → send proposal
rules.message: Hi {name}, based on what you shared, here is our proposal. Happy to adjust anything — when would a quick call suit you?

rules.name: Proposal stuck 3 days
rules.message: Hi {name}, did you get a chance to look at the proposal? Any questions I can answer?

rules.name: Hot lead → alert the team
rules.message: The AI summary marks this lead HOT. Call now while interest is high.

rules.name: Lead idle 14 days → task
rules.taskTitle: Decide: revive or close this lead
rules.message: No movement in 2 weeks. Revive with an offer or mark as Lost.
